Summary of the figure: built on experiment 7's committee diagram (two independent member trunks, averaged belief field, min-confidence gate — all unchanged, drawn in ink), and added the one thing this experiment changes, in red: a tap on each member's 112-d GAP feature feeding a new "within-place invariance" annotation — a glyph of one place shot across three training surveys, with text explaining the standardised, position-grouped batch penalty (weight 10) that squeezes out survey-specific directions while leaving the cell head, decode, and export untouched. I grew the canvas from 500→580 and pushed the existing (unchanged, ochre) per-member augmentation note down to make room, re-routing its connecting leader to match.
